fm.upload_where: Files are uploaded on the business pages (results, staff records, devices, ...)
fm.col.name: Name
fm.delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? It is removed from: {links}. It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored within {days} days.
fm.dup_hint: Files whose content is stored more than once. The oldest copy is kept; other copies can point to it instead. Merging all saves {size}.
fm.dup_hidden: Someone else's copy (location not visible to you)
fm.merge_confirm: This copy is removed; where it was used, the kept copy (identical content) is used instead.
fm.trash_hint: Deleted files stay here for {days} days and can be restored to where they were; then they are removed for good. A file cannot be restored when its record no longer exists.
fm.err.is_kept: This is the kept copy and cannot be merged
fm.err.kept_missing: The kept copy is not intact; merging is not possible now
file.err.restore_gone: The record this file belonged to no longer exists; it cannot be restored
menu_admin.hint: Rename menu entries, change their order or hide unused ones. Which pages exist and who may open them is set by roles; hiding only leaves an entry out of the menu.
menu_admin.locked: This entry must stay so that menu management can be reached
menu_admin.rename_hint: Fill in every enabled language; leave all empty to use the built-in name "{name}".
menu_admin.reset_confirm: Go back to the built-in names and order and show every entry?
menu.err.parent: Entries can only be reordered within their own group
menu.err.names: Fill in a name for every enabled language, or none
i18n.hint: After adding a language, translate every entry under "Translations"; it can be enabled only at 100%. The original is Simplified Chinese. Entries cover all screen text and configured names (fields, options, statistics pages, roles, menus...).
i18n.disable_confirm: Disable {name}? People who chose it will see the default language.
i18n.name_hint: As written in the language itself, e.g. 日本語, Français
i18n.added: Language added; now fill in the translations
i18n.unsaved: {n} changes are not saved yet; save them first
i18n.import_check: {ok} rows can be imported, {skipped} skipped (empty or unchanged), {bad} with problems will not be imported.
i18n.err.incomplete: {n} entries are not translated yet; a language can be enabled only at 100%
i18n.err.keep_on: The original and the default language cannot be disabled
i18n.err.delete_enabled: Only a language that is not enabled can be deleted (not the original)
i18n.err.required_enabled: An enabled language cannot be left empty
backup.what: Each backup has two parts: the database (a zip file, downloadable) and the uploaded files (a folder with the same name; unchanged files are shared with the previous backup and take no extra space).
backup.key_note: Encrypted data such as ID numbers needs APP_KEY from .env. Keep a separate copy of the .env file; restoring on another server needs the same APP_KEY.
backup.time_hint: 24-hour clock, e.g. 02:00; Windows Task Scheduler must run php omps schedule:run
backup.keep_hint: Automatic, before-restore and before-upgrade backups are deleted after this; manual ones are kept
backup.delete_confirm: Delete the backup file "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
backup.restore_warn: Restoring replaces all current data and files with this backup. The current data is backed up first; everyone signs in again afterwards.
backup.restoring: Restoring; do not close the page...
backup.err.folder: The backup folder cannot be written
backup.err.busy: Another backup or restore is running; try again later
backup.err.space: Not enough disk space for the backup
backup.err.write: Writing the backup failed; see the system log
backup.err.not_backup: This is not an OMPS backup
backup.err.key: This backup was made with another APP_KEY; encrypted data would be unreadable, so it cannot be restored
backup.err.before: The safety backup before restoring failed; nothing was restored
backup.err.files: Restoring the files failed (the folder may be in use); please check the folder and try again
backup.err.restore: Restore failed; see the system log. The safety backup made before restoring brings back the previous state
backup.err.files_missing: This backup's files folder is missing (it belongs next to the zip); it cannot be restored
wb.bar_legend: The line is the time used; more than 10 points behind it is lagging
wb.col.name: Name
wb.sys.task_never: Never run; create the Windows scheduled task (see the installation guide)
notify.msg.missing_translation: A screen text has no translation: {lang} · {key}. Please add it in Languages
i18n.missing_hint: Entries used on a page without a translation (shown as ⟦key⟧). Clear the list after adding them.
